Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human hepatocyte growth factor receptor (CHEMBL3717). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_records on activities.record_id to retrieve compound_key. Join docs on compound_records.doc_id to retrieve pubmed_id_or_doi. Inner join compound_structures to require canonical_smiles. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL3717, standard_type IC50, and presence of both canonical_smiles and pubmed_id_or_doi. Return all requested columns without deduplication. Sort by all requested columns.
